name: setlife-solutions
description: Setlife Solutions marketing site + GraphQL API (Next.js 12 monolith) deployed to Heroku.

API_V1_URL.description: Public URL of this app's own GraphQL endpoint, e.g. https://<app-name>.herokuapp.com/api/v1. The Apollo client reads this at build time to talk to the same app over HTTP. Must be set AFTER the app is created (chicken-and-egg with the Heroku hostname).

POSTGRES_DB_HOST.description: Postgres host. The heroku-postgresql addon provisions DATABASE_URL; the host segment must be copied here. The app reads POSTGRES_DB_* directly, not DATABASE_URL.

POSTGRES_DB_USERNAME.description: Postgres username, copied from the heroku-postgresql DATABASE_URL.

POSTGRES_DB_PASSWORD.description: Postgres password, copied from the heroku-postgresql DATABASE_URL.

POSTGRES_DB_NAME.description: Postgres database name, copied from the heroku-postgresql DATABASE_URL.

SENDGRID_API_KEY.description: SendGrid API key for transactional email (consultation + contributor-inquiry forms).

CONSULTATION_FORM_EMAIL.description: Inbox that receives consultation form submissions.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key for client-side S3 uploads from ContributorInquiryForm. Exposed to the browser via next.config.js. NOT set in current prod - the upload feature is silently disabled. Leave unset unless you intend to re-enable uploads.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret key, pairs with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID. Same caveats - not set in current prod.

DISCORD_WEBHOOK.description: Discord webhook URL for form-submission notifications. Set in prod, not in staging.

NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS.description: Google Analytics measurement ID. Optional - gtag script is skipped if unset.
